incompleteCases.question: 物流延迟类工单按关联订单客户所在州、工单会员的当前等级ID组合统计工单数；未知属性保留NULL，按工单数取20，同数按州和等级ID升序NULL最后。

itemEvidence.finalSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_city) FROM customers;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) FROM products;

SELECT order_id, order_item_id, freight_value
FROM order_items ORDER BY freight_value DESC,order_id ASC,order_item_id ASC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_weight_g > 5000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_comment_title IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM(review_comment_title)<>'';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE price < 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members m JOIN member_levels l ON l.level_id=m.level_id WHERE l.level_name='黄金会员';
SELECT member_id,points FROM members WHERE points IS NOT NULL ORDER BY points DESC,member_id ASC LIMIT 10;
SELECT warehouse_id,capacity FROM warehouses WHERE capacity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY capacity DESC,warehouse_id ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupons;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 4;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE quantity < safety_stock;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT keyword) FROM search_logs;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaigns WHERE status = 3;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM product_price_history;
SELECT SUM(price) FROM order_items;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM order_items LIMIT 201
SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_reviews GROUP BY review_score ORDER BY review_score LIMIT 201

SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM products
WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_category_name ORDER BY cnt DESC,product_category_name ASC LIMIT 10;
SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(freight_value), 2) AS total
FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total DESC,seller_id ASC LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card') AS credit_card, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'boleto') AS boleto FROM order_payments LIMIT 201
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM members GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 201
SELECT campaign_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM campaigns GROUP BY campaign_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT reason_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM refunds GROUP BY reason_code ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) FROM refunds WHERE status = 4 LIMIT 201
SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM inventory;
SELECT movement_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory_movements GROUP BY movement_type ORDER BY movement_type LIMIT 201
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 201
SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM support_tickets GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY category_id LIMIT 201
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM settlements GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(SUM(commission), 2) FROM settlements LIMIT 201
SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_category_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1500 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT MAX(price) AS max_price, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM order_items;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1), calendar AS (SELECT generate_series(MIN(m), MAX(m), INTERVAL '1 month') AS m FROM monthly), aligned AS (SELECT c.m, m.cnt FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN monthly m USING (m)) SELECT m AS month, ROUND((cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m))::numeric / NULLIF(LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m), 0), 4) AS mom_rate FROM aligned ORDER BY m LIMIT 201

WITH anchor AS(SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS mx FROM orders) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp>=a.mx::date-INTERVAL '89 days' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<a.mx::date+INTERVAL '1 day';

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS hr, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC,hr ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date;

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL), 0), 4) AS late_rate FROM orders LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', requested_at) AS month, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS total FROM refunds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600), 2) FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', review_creation_date) AS month, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM order_reviews GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members
WHERE last_login_date > (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members) - 30;
SELECT c.customer_unique_id,COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY cnt DESC,c.customer_unique_id ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY order_cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT oi.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM order_items oi GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY order_cnt DESC,oi.seller_id ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN product_price_history h ON h.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE h.product_id IS NULL;
SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_value FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY avg_value DESC NULLS LAST, payment_type ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state,ROUND(AVG(r.review_score),2) AS avg_score FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,c.customer_state ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH order_types AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, payment_type FROM order_payments) SELECT p.payment_type, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM order_types p JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY p.payment_type ORDER BY avg_score DESC NULLS LAST, p.payment_type ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state GROUP BY r.macro_region ORDER BY sales DESC NULLS LAST, r.macro_region ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT m.level_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT c.campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM coupon_usages cu JOIN coupons cp ON cp.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = cp.campaign_id GROUP BY c.campaign_id ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.campaign_id ASC LIMIT 201
SELECT c.discount_type, ROUND(SUM(cu.discount_amount), 2) AS total FROM coupon_usages cu JOIN coupons c ON c.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, SUM(w.capacity) AS total_capacity FROM warehouses w LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code GROUP BY r.macro_region ORDER BY total_capacity DESC NULLS LAST, r.macro_region ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT i.warehouse_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_qty, ROUND(AVG(i.quantity), 2) AS avg_qty FROM inventory i GROUP BY i.warehouse_id ORDER BY total_qty DESC NULLS LAST, i.warehouse_id ASC LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM support_tickets st LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = st.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.customer_state ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total
FROM settlements GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(total_amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total DESC,seller_id ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.refund_id) AS cnt FROM refund_items ri JOIN refunds rf ON rf.refund_id = ri.refund_id AND rf.order_id = ri.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, p.product_category_name ASC LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM orders o LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id), 2) AS avg_per_customer FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_per_customer DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT m.level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS cnt FROM members m JOIN user_tag_map tm ON tm.member_id = m.member_id JOIN user_tags t ON t.tag_id = tm.tag_id WHERE t.tag_code = 'CHURN_RISK' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

WITH products_by_brand AS (SELECT b.brand_id, p.product_id FROM brands b LEFT JOIN product_brand_map bm ON bm.brand_id = b.brand_id AND bm.is_current IS TRUE LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = bm.product_id) SELECT b.brand_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.product_id) AS product_cnt, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM products_by_brand b LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY b.brand_id ORDER BY sales DESC NULLS LAST, b.brand_id ASC LIMIT 201

WITH per_shipment AS (SELECT s.shipment_id, s.status, COUNT(t.tracking_id) AS cnt FROM shipments s LEFT JOIN shipment_tracking t ON t.shipment_id = s.shipment_id GROUP BY s.shipment_id, s.status) SELECT status, ROUND(AVG(cnt), 2) AS avg_events FROM per_shipment GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT product_category_name,ROUND(AVG(product_weight_g),2) AS avg_weight FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_category_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,product_category_name ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.level_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY m.level_id ORDER BY sales DESC NULLS LAST, m.level_id ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT w.region_code, COUNT(*) AS shipments, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS orders FROM shipments s LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.region_code ORDER BY shipments DESC, w.region_code ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state,m.level_id,COUNT(*) AS tickets FROM support_tickets st JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id=st.category_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=st.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.member_id=st.member_id WHERE tc.category_name='物流延迟' GROUP BY c.customer_state,m.level_id ORDER BY tickets DESC,c.customer_state ASC NULLS LAST,m.level_id ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20;

SELECT mr.level_id AS referrer_level, mii.level_id AS invitee_level, COUNT(*) AS referrals, ROUND(SUM(rf.reward_amount), 2) AS reward FROM referrals rf LEFT JOIN members mr ON mr.member_id = rf.referrer_member_id LEFT JOIN members mii ON mii.member_id = rf.invitee_member_id GROUP BY mr.level_id, mii.level_id ORDER BY referrals DESC, mr.level_id ASC NULLS LAST, mii.level_id ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT bm.brand_id,ROUND(SUM(oi.price),2) AS sales FROM order_items oi JOIN product_brand_map bm ON bm.product_id=oi.product_id AND bm.is_current IS TRUE GROUP BY bm.brand_id ORDER BY sales DESC NULLS LAST,bm.brand_id ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT st.event_code,c.customer_state,COUNT(DISTINCT st.shipment_id) AS shipments
FROM shipment_tracking st LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id=st.shipment_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=s.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
GROUP BY st.event_code,c.customer_state
ORDER BY shipments DESC,st.event_code ASC NULLS LAST,c.customer_state ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20;

SELECT st.category_id, st.priority, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS tickets, COUNT(tm.message_id) AS messages FROM support_tickets st LEFT JOIN ticket_messages tm ON tm.ticket_id = st.ticket_id GROUP BY st.category_id, st.priority ORDER BY tickets DESC, st.category_id ASC NULLS LAST, st.priority ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

WITH changed AS(
 SELECT p.product_category_name,pph.product_id,pph.new_price-pph.old_price AS delta
 FROM product_price_history pph JOIN products p ON p.product_id=pph.product_id
 WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL),
means AS(SELECT product_category_name,ROUND(AVG(delta),2) AS avg_price_change FROM changed GROUP BY 1),
order_counts AS(SELECT x.product_category_name,COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders
 FROM(SELECT DISTINCT product_category_name,product_id FROM changed)x
 LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=x.product_id GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.product_category_name,m.avg_price_change,o.orders FROM means m JOIN order_counts o USING(product_category_name)
ORDER BY o.orders DESC,m.product_category_name ASC LIMIT 20;

SELECT r.macro_region, im.movement_type, COUNT(*) AS movements, SUM(im.quantity) AS qty FROM inventory_movements im LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = im.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code GROUP BY r.macro_region, im.movement_type ORDER BY movements DESC, r.macro_region ASC NULLS LAST, im.movement_type ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS gmv_with_freight, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales_without_freight FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01' LIMIT 201

WITH per_user AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct FROM per_user LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE m.member_id IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS penetration_pct FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_score IN (1,2)) / COUNT(*), 2) AS low_pct
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY low_pct DESC,c.customer_state ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS ctr_pct FROM search_logs LIMIT 201

WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS mau FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1), calendar AS (SELECT generate_series(DATE '2018-01-01', DATE '2018-12-01', INTERVAL '1 month')::date AS month) SELECT c.month, m.mau FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN monthly m USING (month) ORDER BY c.month LIMIT 201

WITH per_member AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv FROM members m LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.level_id) SELECT level_id, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(AVG(order_cnt), 2) AS orders_per_user, ROUND(AVG(gmv), 2) AS gmv_per_user FROM per_member GROUP BY level_id ORDER BY gmv_per_user DESC NULLS LAST, level_id ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

WITH bp AS(SELECT b.brand_id,p.product_id FROM brands b
 LEFT JOIN product_brand_map bm ON bm.brand_id=b.brand_id AND bm.is_current IS TRUE
 LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id=bm.product_id),
totals AS(SELECT brand_id,COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS product_cnt FROM bp GROUP BY 1),
sales AS(SELECT bp.brand_id,COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS sold_products,SUM(oi.price) AS sales
 FROM bp JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=bp.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id
 WHERE o.order_status NOT IN('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY 1)
SELECT t.brand_id,t.product_cnt,COALESCE(s.sold_products,0) AS sold_products,ROUND(s.sales,2) AS sales,
 ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(s.sold_products,0)/NULLIF(t.product_cnt,0),2) AS sell_through_pct
FROM totals t JOIN sales s USING(brand_id) WHERE s.sales IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sales DESC,t.brand_id ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH user_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, BOOL_OR(m.member_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_member, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1), groups(is_member,user_type) AS (VALUES (true, 'member'), (false, 'non_member')) SELECT g.user_type, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(u.customer_unique_id) FILTER (WHERE u.order_cnt >= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(u.customer_unique_id), 0), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct FROM groups g LEFT JOIN user_orders u ON u.is_member = g.is_member GROUP BY g.user_type ORDER BY g.user_type LIMIT 201

WITH user_gmv AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id), ranked AS (SELECT gmv, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ROUND(gmv, 2) DESC, customer_unique_id ASC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM user_gmv) SELECT ROUND(SUM(gmv) FILTER (WHERE rn <= CEIL(n * 0.2)) / NULLIF(SUM(gmv), 0), 4) AS top20_gmv_ratio FROM ranked LIMIT 201

WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(moved_at) AS mx FROM inventory_movements), outbound AS (SELECT im.warehouse_id, SUM(im.quantity) AS out_qty, COUNT(*) AS records FROM inventory_movements im CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE im.movement_type = 2 AND im.moved_at >= a.mx::date - INTERVAL '89 days' AND im.moved_at < a.mx::date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY im.warehouse_id), stock AS (SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS stock_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id), combined AS (SELECT w.warehouse_id, s.stock_qty, CASE WHEN a.mx IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN o.records IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE o.out_qty END AS out_qty FROM warehouses w CROSS JOIN anchor a LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN outbound o ON o.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id) SELECT warehouse_id, stock_qty, out_qty AS out_qty_90d, ROUND(90.0 * stock_qty / NULLIF(out_qty, 0), 1) AS turnover_days FROM combined ORDER BY turnover_days DESC NULLS LAST, warehouse_id ASC LIMIT 201

WITH first_order AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp))::date AS first_month FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id), monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month, c.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2), summed AS (SELECT m.month, ROUND(SUM(m.gmv) FILTER (WHERE f.first_month = m.month), 2) AS new_customer_gmv, ROUND(SUM(m.gmv) FILTER (WHERE f.first_month < m.month), 2) AS returning_gmv FROM monthly m JOIN first_order f ON f.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id GROUP BY m.month), calendar AS (SELECT generate_series(DATE '2018-01-01', DATE '2018-12-01', INTERVAL '1 month')::date AS month) SELECT c.month, s.new_customer_gmv, s.returning_gmv FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN summed s USING (month) ORDER BY c.month LIMIT 201
